title: Production of N4ED 10th Anniversary Documentary Film
description: TERMS OF REFERENCE (TOR) Production of N4ED 10th Anniversary Documentary Film 1. Background Nutrition 4 Education & Development – New Name [Nexus 4 Empowerment & Development] - N4ED is an Ethiopian Civil Society Organization e stablished in 2016, committed to improving child nutrition, education, child development, family wellbeing, and community empowerment through sustainable and preventive approaches. Over the past ten years, N4ED has implemented diverse programs focusing on nutrition education, child care and development, gender and GBV response, youth empowerment, family wellbeing, livelihoods, and community development initiatives across different communities. As part of celebrating its 10th Anniversary in September 2026, N4ED plans to produce a high-quality documentary film showcasing its journey, achievements, impact stories, lessons learned, partnerships, and future vision. To achieve this, N4ED invites qualified media companies, production agencies, documentary filmmakers, and experienced professionals to submit proposals for the production of a 25–30 minutes documentary film. 2. Purpose of the Assignment The purpose of this assignment is to produce an engaging, professional, and impactful documentary that captures: The story and evolution of N4ED over the last 10 years. Organizational milestones, achievements, and challenges. Voices and experiences of beneficiaries, staff, volunteers, partners, donors, and stakeholders. Programmatic impact and transformation stories. N4ED’s vision and future direction. The documentary should serve as both a celebratory anniversary product and a communication, visibility, fundraising, and institutional storytelling tool. 3. Scope of Work The selected consultant/company will be responsible for the complete production process, including but not limited to: Pre-Production Conduct consultation meetings with the N4ED team. Review organizational background materials. Develop the documentary concept and creative approach. Develop the storyline, script outline, interview framework, and production plan. Identify filming requirements and develop a production schedule. Edited founder's recorded message/video statement (approximately 2–3 minutes), Content Development The documentary may incorporate: Existing organizational photos, videos, and archival materials. Newly filmed footage. Interviews with key stakeholders including: Founders Staff and volunteers Beneficiaries Partners, supporters, donors, and collaborators Community members and stakeholders Voiceover narration (if proposed). Supporting graphics, captions, animation, or other visual storytelling elements where relevant. Production / Filming Conduct filming and interviews. Capture high-quality video, audio, and supporting visuals. Ensure professional lighting, sound, and overall production quality. Post-Production Video editing and storytelling development. Sound editing and sound design. Color correction and visual enhancement. Motion graphics, subtitles, and transitions (where applicable). Integration of archival materials and newly captured footage. Revision rounds based on N4ED feedback. Finalization of all video products. 4. Deliverables The selected consultant/company shall provide: Documentary concept notes and proposed creative direction. Production work plan and timeline. Draft documentary version for review. Final documentary film (25–30 minutes). A professionally edited founder’s recorded message/video statement (approximately 2–3 minutes). Short promotional teaser/trailer (optional). Final deliverables in agreed digital formats suitable for: Event screening Social media Website and communication purposes. 5. Required Qualifications & Experience Applicants may be companies, agencies, production companies, or individual professionals. Preference will be given to applicants with: Proven experience in documentary filmmaking. Experience producing documentaries for NGOs, development organizations, humanitarian organizations, or social impact initiatives. Strong storytelling, filming, interviewing, and editing capabilities. Demonstrated experience handling archival materials, testimonials, and impact storytelling. Strong portfolio of similar work. 6. Proposal Submission Requirements Interested applicants should submit: Technical Proposal Including: Brief organizational/company profile or consultant background. Understanding of the assignment. Proposed creative concept/documentary approach. Proposed methodology and production process. Portfolio Applicants must submit: Previous documentary work samples. Examples of similar assignments. Financial Proposal Detailed quotation including: Production costs. Editing and post-production costs. Any additional relevant expenses. Applicants are encouraged to propose packages and provide transparent pricing. 7. Duration of Assignment The assignment is expected to be completed within 5 weeks, with final delivery before the organization’s anniversary celebration in September 20

title: Business Development & Market Research Officer (One-Month Contract)
description: Job Title: Business Development & Market Research Officer Company: Genesis Technologies Location: Wolaita Sodo, Ethiopia Employment Type: One-Month Contract Reports To: Founder / Managing Director Application Preference: Candidates based in Wolaita Sodo are strongly encouraged to apply About Genesis Technologies Genesis Technologies is a U.S.-based emerging technology startup focused on delivering practical, impactful, and locally relevant digital solutions. The company aims to provide software development, digital transformation, business systems, IT consulting, and technology support services to institutions, businesses, and organizations in Ethiopia. As part of its early startup phase, Genesis Technologies is conducting focused market-entry research and business development activities in Ethiopia and Wolaita sodo being a pilot phase. The goal of this assignment is to better understand local market needs, identify customer pain points, map business opportunities, and support the company in shaping its early service and product direction. Position Summary Genesis Technologies is seeking a smart, disciplined, proactive, and professional Business Development & Market Research Officer for a one-month contract assignment in Wolaita Sodo. The selected candidate will support the company in conducting structured market research, identifying sectors with unmet technology needs, engaging potential clients, gathering business insights, and helping build an early pipeline of opportunities. This role is both field-based and strategic, requiring someone who is comfortable meeting organizations and businesses in person, communicating professionally, and documenting findings clearly. This is an important early-stage role that will directly contribute to Genesis Technologies’ market-entry planning and growth strategy. Key Responsibilities Market Research and Opportunity Mapping Conduct field-based and desk-based market research in Wolaita Sodo and nearby areas. Identify businesses, institutions, and sectors with unmet needs in software, IT services, automation, digitization, and technology support. Assess customer pain points across sectors such as education, healthcare, retail, hospitality, NGOs, private businesses, and public institutions. Gather and document information on customer needs, operational gaps, and possible service opportunities. Conduct basic competitor and substitute-service analysis within the local market. Prepare structured findings and recommendations for Genesis Technologies leadership. Business Development and Lead Identification Identify and approach potential clients relevant to Genesis Technologies’ service areas. Introduce the company and its value proposition in a clear, professional, and persuasive manner. Build positive working relationships with business owners, administrators, managers, and institutional representatives. Generate and qualify leads for possible pilot projects, service engagements, and future business opportunities. Maintain an organized list of prospects, organizations visited, and opportunity status. Conduct timely and professional follow-up with potential leads where appropriate. Client Discovery and Needs Assessment Meet with businesses and institutions to understand their operational challenges and technology-related needs. Gather initial information on workflows, pain points, service gaps, and possible system needs. Document findings clearly and submit them in a useful format for management review. Support Genesis Technologies in understanding which services and solutions are most viable for the local market. Brand Representation and Local Presence Represent Genesis Technologies professionally during field visits, meetings, calls, and introductions. Help establish the company’s credibility and visibility in the local market. Support networking efforts and relevant local relationship-building opportunities. Provide practical field insight on how Genesis Technologies should position itself in Wolaita Sodo. Reporting and Deliverables Submit regular updates on field activity, meetings conducted, sectors assessed, and leads identified. Maintain accurate records of organizations contacted and insights gathered. Prepare a final summary report at the end of the assignment with findings, opportunities, challenges, and recommendations. Expected Deliverables During the one-month assignment, the successful candidate is expected to contribute to the following outcomes: A mapped list of priority sectors and business opportunities in Wolaita Sodo A list of businesses, institutions, and organizations contacted or visited A pipeline of qualified leads or potential client opportunities Documented customer pain points and market observations Competitor and substitute-service observations A final market research and business development summary report with recommendations Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, Economics, Information Sys
